statements.notes: Collagen Protein proteinis made with grass-fed, pasture-raised, hydrolyzed collagen peptides (Type I & III).
Unflavored and virtually tasteless, you can add Collagen to your coffee, smoothies, shakes, and even to your baking recipes to get an added boost of protein whenever you need it.

Suggested Use: Take 1 serving daily to supplement the diet with additional protein or as directed by a healthcare professional. Do not use this product as a meal replacement or exceed suggested use without supervision of a healthcare professional.
